summary.text: Bill MacGregor is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Suffolk District since June 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Devin Kreinbring of the Workers Party.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as loan officer.

paragraphs.text: MacGregor graduated from Catholic Memorial High School in 1997 and earned a B.A. in economics from Assumption University in 2001.

His career experience includes work as a loan officer with CrossCountry Mortgage, LLC, as chief of staff to former Boston City Councilor Matt O'Malley, and as a residential leasing associate with Boston Realty Advisors, and he served on the Roslindale Parade Committee.
He took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on June 7, 2023, succeeding Edward Coppinger.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Cannabis Policy Joint, Financial Services Joint, Economic Development and Emerging Technologies Joint, and Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy Joint committees.
